$comment: Accepted high and critical advisories in production dependencies. See docs/educateos/security/dependency-scanning.md before adding an entry; every entry needs a reason and an issue or expiry, and is reviewed in the pull request that adds it.

advisories.title: basic-ftp: Quadratic-time CPU denial of service in Client.list() Unix directory-listing parser (RE_LINE backtracking)
advisories.reason: Reached only through @cloudflare/puppeteer > @puppeteer/browsers > proxy-agent > get-uri, a Node-only proxy path the Worker never takes; nothing in EducateOS speaks FTP.

advisories.title: extract-zip allows arbitrary file writes through symlink archive entries
advisories.reason: Reached only through @cloudflare/puppeteer > @puppeteer/browsers, whose browser download and unzip code is Node-only and never runs in the Worker (Browser Rendering supplies the browser).

advisories.title: extract-zip unvalidated symlink path traversal
advisories.reason: Reached only through @cloudflare/puppeteer > @puppeteer/browsers, whose browser download and unzip code is Node-only and never runs in the Worker (Browser Rendering supplies the browser).

advisories.title: launch-editor: `fs.existsSync()` existence check can be bypassed on Windows
advisories.reason: Dev server and build tool only; Vite is not bundled into any Worker. The advisory needs a Windows dev machine opening files through launch-editor. Fixed by bumping the exact catalog pin to 7.3.7.

advisories.title: Forge: X.509 basicConstraints bypass in verifyCertificateChain() via deprecated extension OIDs 2.5.29.10 and 2.5.29.13
advisories.reason: Reached only through expo > @expo/cli > @expo/code-signing-certificates, the build and dev-server CLI that runs on developer machines and in builds, not in the app binary.

advisories.title: Forge: RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature forgery via non-canonical DigestInfo encoding

advisories.title: Zod can exhaust memory while validating oversized constrained collections
advisories.reason: zod 3.25.76 is reached only through expo > @expo/cli, the build and dev-server CLI, not the app binary; the app's own zod is separate.
